title: feat(nsparyinc): nspar y-probe same-tick union own-lock: reverse fails, face fails
science: Same-tick union own lock on nspar y-probes: both bits fail, with the face failure precisely diagnosed (D lacks +e1 and -e2). One of the few cells where the same-tick rung is a double negative, and the note notes the same seed's x-probe frame holds face - a within-seed frame contrast.
